title: Predicting three orange orbs at 9:45 at Contact in the Desert

tellings.quote: And so I told the whole group and I were in advance. I said at 9:45 there'll be three orange orbs that appear underneath the clouds.

plain: At Contact in the Desert, a UFO gathering near Palm Springs, California, in 2025, Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs and whom NASA has studied, says he told the whole group ahead of time that at 9:45 three orange orbs would appear beneath the clouds. He tells it as his own experience. If true, it would mean he could predict the appearances in advance.
